self.text: Hey! I’m Zoltan, mid‑30s, from Kenya, and I love the rhythm of swing dancing—nothing beats moving to music after a long day. I’m a Canon enthusiast, always eager to capture the perfect shot, but I’m not into gear debates. I’m looking for a focused practice session on specific shots, and I’d love someone to walk me through post‑processing techniques. I’m free Sunday afternoon, so let’s pick a spot that’s quiet and inspiring. I’m all about learning together and sharing good vibes. Looking forward to shooting and chatting about the craft over a cup of coffee afterwards!
